formFields.title: Aegis Capital Agent: Autonomous Solana Sentinel powered by OOBE SAP MCP
formFields.description: Aegis is a production-grade autonomous capital agent built for Solana and Steve Capital. Powered by OOBE Protocol's Synapse Agent Protocol (SAP MCP), Aegis manages capital through multi-layered programmable guardrails: a 2.5% max drawdown circuit breaker, mathematically optimal Kelly Criterion position sizing, Pyth Oracle quote verification (<= 3 bps slippage), non-custodial browser signature gating (> $250), and x402 JSON-RPC agent-to-agent settlement receipts. Featuring specialist sub-agent vaults for Ace Data Cloud research and MultiHopper 3-hop automated routing.

formFields.projectSummary: Aegis provides open-source, non-custodial risk policy guardrails and an autonomous execution engine for Solana agents using OOBE Protocol SAP MCP. It solves the primary barrier to autonomous capital delegation: unbounded loss and key exfiltration risk.
formFields.problemStatement: Autonomous AI agents moving real capital on Solana currently face severe risks of unbounded drawdown, flash slippage exploits, and custodial vulnerability. Users hesitate to fund agents without deterministic execution mandates and mathematical risk guardrails.
formFields.solutionArchitecture: Aegis introduces a 5-layer deterministic risk firewall: 1) Daily drawdown circuit breaker (halts execution at 2.5% loss), 2) Kelly Criterion dynamic allocation (f* = (pb-q)/b), 3) Pyth Oracle quote verification (max 3 bps slippage), 4) Non-custodial owner approval thresholds (> $250), and 5) x402 cryptographic agent-to-agent settlement receipts over JSON-RPC streamable HTTP.
